ideas.pitch: A biometric authentication middleware combining MojoAuth with real-time PPG pulse-rate signals captured from webcam video to verify liveness and presence.
ideas.title: BioSignal Auth & Access Guard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the sponsor MojoAuth directly for identity workflows while fitting the BIOS life-and-computation theme perfectly by bridging biological signals with authentication.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous web agent using Browserbase to continuously extract, structure, and index open-source bioinformatics research papers and clinical trial updates for rapid querying.
ideas.title: Browserbase Bio-Data Scraper
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly integrates sponsor Browserbase for robust cloud browser automation, addressing the hard engineering pattern by handling dynamic JS-heavy life science portals.

ideas.pitch: A low-code biological simulation and tracking dashboard built on Momen that models daily caloric burn and fatigue using simple wearable CSV uploads.
ideas.title: Momen Metabolic Twin
ideas.why_it_could_win: Utilizes sponsor Momen for rapid UI and workflow generation, allowing the team to focus on the biological calculation engine and win through speed and clean presentation.

ideas.pitch: A zero-knowledge verifiable credential system for sharing anonymous genetic predisposition summaries securely with researchers without leaking raw DNA data.
ideas.title: NamoID Genetic Credential Vault
ideas.why_it_could_win: Integrates sponsor NamoID for identity verification and credential management, addressing hard cryptographic and privacy engineering in bioinformatics.

ideas.title: Tin-Bio Edge Monitor
